verdict_summary: No functional blocking issue in the two undeployed source drafts. One nonblocking trainer docstring inconsistency. This is not a complete pipeline or runtime acceptance.
review_type: experiment-bridge Phase 2.5 fresh source-only pipeline-draft review

reviewer.attribution: Supplied delegation metadata; underlying model/runtime was not independently attested.

scope: Exactly merge_partition_cpu.py and train_fixed_epochs_private.py in this run directory, both undeployed. Plan, accepted collection review/preparation metadata, unchanged collector/model/evaluator sources and parent implementations were read as dependencies. No launcher, stager, continuous-validation selector, native-evaluation automation or checkpoint cleanup implementation is included.
future_review_note: The merger requires the future complete-pipeline PASS record. This draft report must not be substituted for it.

non_blocking_issues.subject: Module docstring still describes best-only retention
non_blocking_issues.evidence: The docstring says only best.pth is retained, but lines 254-258 now write the requested epoch_NNN.pth files. CLI help, config.checkpoint_retention, each fixed checkpoint selection_policy, and completion.retained_weights correctly describe the new behavior.
non_blocking_issues.impact: Documentation inconsistency only; it does not change model updates, retention paths or machine-readable selection provenance.
non_blocking_issues.suggested_change: Update the docstring to mention optional temporary fixed-epoch checkpoints pending continuous developer validation.

findings.subject: Minimal trainer change; model, loss, optimizer and cached-best selection invariant
findings.evidence: The exact archived parent SHA matches the supplied value. Removing the added retain-epochs argparse entry, its uniqueness/range assertion, and the fixed-epoch save block, then restoring only the two retention metadata values makes the entire trainer AST exactly equal to the parent. load_data, forward and evaluate already match without transformation. Model initialization/loading, all objective arguments, AdamW, clipping, seed/order, ABC update/frozen-C1 checks and strict-improvement cached best selection are unchanged.

findings.subject: Actual prepared jobs, partition counts and dynamic shard ordering
findings.evidence: Saved preparation metadata contains 1762 unique sequence/query pairs across 881 TRAIN names and 196 across 98 developer-VAL names, exactly two distinct queries per name, with no name intersection. Deterministic balance reconstruction reproduces all saved ordered jobs and workloads: TRAIN shard counts 440/440/441/441; VAL 49/49/49/49. The merger uses those dynamic counts, checks all names against the actual split at execution, requires exactly two per name, and requires concatenated config jobs to equal the prepared ordered list before creating output.

findings.subject: Old4 teacher and run identity despite historical reference metadata
findings.evidence: The preparation reference embeds the previous epoch46 configuration as a dataset/schema reference. The merger correctly takes the teacher from prepared.teacher, verifies retained old4 SHA a165e06ffd8d0288d7db358359611d3ab1ed919941ff5fc2ccaa0cb14ddded72, and compares each new shard prefix/future epoch with prepared.teacher_epoch=4. It copies the actual accepted shard configuration into merged output, so the old reference epoch46 does not become the new teacher provenance. New shard/output paths match the unchanged collection shell.

findings.subject: Query schema, current/history GT checks and decision causality
findings.evidence: The merger retains the accepted seven-region/five-candidate schema, action masks, 1024-history alignment, finite/range checks and exact ordered concatenate/reload checks. It reloads each query and every valid past-frame box from the LasHeR TRAIN dataset and requires IoU agreement within 1e-4; invalid past GT must retain -1. Actual DECISION_FIELDS excludes all five trainer LABEL_FIELDS and motion_targets, and unchanged trainer forward passes only DECISION_FIELDS. Distinct quarter queries remain distinct under the unchanged sequence/query/prefix-policy deduplication.

findings.subject: Future-label provenance is preserved and not overstated
findings.evidence: The unchanged collector copies decision arrays before future decode, uses per-action private histories, then labels the three own-policy continuation steps against TRAIN GT. The merger checks own-policy epoch4 provenance, serial execution, copy-before-future metadata and finite/range-valid future values. Its receipt explicitly states that future IoUs are source-linked teacher outputs and are not independently rerun. The reviewer also did not rerun future labels.

findings.subject: Fixed-epoch checkpoint contents and selection provenance
findings.evidence: Requested epochs must be unique and within 1..epochs before any CUDA setup. Saves occur after that epoch training and cached validation, independently of cached-best improvement. Each payload preserves module/model/epoch/args/validation/selection_policy, matching the unchanged evaluator strict state_dict load and required args. Filenames are epoch_020.pth, epoch_040.pth and epoch_060.pth for the planned schedule. Fixed checkpoints explicitly say pending full continuous developer validation; best.pth and best_validation.npz continue to represent cached selection. completion.json lists all retained filenames.

findings.subject: Declared scientific and operational boundaries
findings.evidence: These drafts provide audited cache merging and temporary checkpoint candidates. They do not perform full98 continuous validation, final checkpoint selection, native tests or removal of unselected weights. The plan discloses prior native-test-guided development, two states per video, prefix1024 and frozen GOLA/C1 cached training; there is no untouched-test or all-frame/end-to-end claim. A single best model is sufficient under the supplied user scope; no three-seed requirement was introduced.

checks.name: Both reviewed source files parse under Python3.8 grammar via ast.parse; syntax only, not a Python3.8 runtime guarantee
Archived parent trainer exact SHA and entire AST equality after only five retention changes
Extracted argparse and exact guard evaluated with standard library only
Exact fixed-epoch save AST executed with in-memory model/save stubs
Actual saved preparation JSON counts, query uniqueness, two-per-name, name disjointness and deterministic balance/order/workload recomputation
Actual module decision-field AST excludes all trainer labels and motion_targets; unchanged accepted schema and evaluator format inspected
Two reviewed source hashes rechecked immediately before report write

limitations: No remote call, GPU query, neural forward, optimizer update, dataset/GT read, checkpoint read or live-job observation was performed. Live collection status is supplied context, not a fresh runtime attestation by this reviewer.

The new shards and merged-cache GT/schema/reload acceptance do not yet exist as results of this review. The merger must run only after completed shards and the future complete-pipeline review; this draft report establishes neither.
No actual torch serialization/load or numerical equality of retained checkpoint outputs was executed. Checkpoint compatibility is source and in-memory payload evidence only.

The trainer imports .recoverability_modules and needs the intended research package execution/staging context. A stager and runnable command are outside this two-file scope and were not approved here.

The future launcher must supply the planned initialization, selector supervision, complete ABC, actual validated training batch and retain schedule. None is established by these defaults or this review.
New-data GPU memory capacity remains unmeasured. Preserve the plan-required actual capacity check before full training.

Full98 continuous evaluation, its selection criterion and coverage, final chosen-weight provenance and cleanup of unselected temporary weights remain future pipeline work. Current best_epoch/best_validation fields are cached-validation values only.

Current/history GT audit logic is independently inspectable, but future IoUs remain provenance/range checked rather than independently replayed. Native-test feedback has already guided development; no untouched formal holdout claim is supported.
